name: Buffalo with sour bamboo
nameVi: Thịt trâu gác bếp xào măng chua
summary: Vietnam Tourism's ethnic desk names thịt trâu gác bếp xào măng chua among Tay dishes of the lake. The VnExpress handbook describes pork over the fire at the houses, and mentions buffalo smoking only as the northwest method. The pork plate stays. This stir-fry stays too.
origin: Tay cooking of the lake, as listed by Vietnam Tourism's ethnic desk on 3 November 2024.
howToEat: The ethnic desk names smoked buffalo stir-fried with sour bamboo. A pan time and a seasoning were not printed.
Dried buffalo, thịt trâu khô, is a separate gift on the district OCOP list. A price is Check on arrival. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: Shown as lake Tay food at the 2024 Northeast festival in Lang Son. A stall at the lake was not named.
seoTitle: Buffalo with sour bamboo at Ba Be
seoDescription: Thịt trâu gác bếp xào măng chua, named by Vietnam Tourism's ethnic desk as Tay food of the lake. A price is Check on arrival.
